feedback: This is the final iteration, so there is no later race to verify a new single-variable change. The candidate matches iteration 10, the best raced design at 234.2 (9 of 20 oval completions, oval progress 0.84). It is identical to that design in geometry and controller, and it is valid against the contract. Iteration 10 is the only design raced with a score above 220, and every later step lowered the score: base_speed 1.8 (iteration 8, 136.1, all runs off track), ki 0.15 (iteration 9, 171.9, oval progress 0.66), and the kd 0.35 change (iteration 5, 89.2). Line loss has stayed near 1.0 per run on the s-bend and slalom in every raced iteration, so the main risk on the unseen track is turn-in geometry on bends, not controller gain. The approved build should be raced unchanged.
requested_changes: No change to the approved build: keep geometry and controller identical to iteration 10 (outer sensors at x = -0.04 and +0.04, y = 0.06; inner sensors at y = 0.03; sensor_size 0.012; kp 3.0, ki 0.05, kd 0.5, base_speed 1.6, line_loss last_direction).

Use the race telemetry (completion, progress, line_loss_events, max_error) to check that the unseen track matches iteration 10's oval behaviour, since the s-bend and slalom were the weak tracks (progress about 0.17 and 0.11).
